_readme: Smell rules enforced locally by .claude/hooks/smell-guard.sh (PostToolUse) and by CI via scripts/ci/agentic-smells.py. Same rules in both places — no divergence. Each rule requires both 'summary' (short label for CI output) and 'message' (detail). Add project-specific rules tagged with 'scope: project' in the section at the end.

rules.summary: Inline // comment may explain WHAT rather than WHY
rules.message: Inline // comments must explain WHY (a non-obvious constraint, invariant, or workaround), never WHAT. English only, one line. If this comment restates what the code already makes obvious, remove it. XML doc (///) above public declarations is required and exempt from this rule.
Blocking on async (.Result / .Wait() / .GetAwaiter().GetResult()) is forbidden. Use await end-to-end. Exception: top-level Program.cs where async host is unavailable — document the reason inline.
async void is forbidden. Return Task instead. Legitimate exception: event handlers (EventHandler / EventArgs signatures).
Empty catch block silently swallows exceptions. Log, rethrow, or handle explicitly.
Hardcoded connection string or credential detected. Use IConfiguration, environment variables, or a secrets manager. See Security section in AGENTS.md.
Console.WriteLine in non-presentation code. Use ILogger<T> for structured logging.
Null-forgiving operator (!) detected. Use only when the compiler cannot infer non-nullability from context; add an XML doc comment above the member explaining why.
FIXME: and STOPSHIP: markers must not be committed. Resolve the issue or open a GitHub Issue to track it.
Dispatcher.Invoke blocks the calling thread. Use Dispatcher.InvokeAsync or marshal via async/await instead.
